verdict.rationale: OCI provides CLI/SDK/REST API access (oracle-cloud-docs-1,5,19) and Terraform state import/export (oracle-cloud-docs-6,7) that could be used to programmatically retrieve resources and configuration, implying some data portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk data-export feature, open-format guarantees, or account-closure data extraction process, and no independent/community evidence confirming successful full data export and departure. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability documentation, open-format export guarantees, and independent confirmation of leaving with all data intact.
